Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: lumbar radiculopathy; bilateral knee pain for 1 year, no injury
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Mild thinning without focal defect.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: High-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss along the posterior weightbearing lateral tibial plateau. Cartilage thinning along the lateral femoral condyle.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Mild heterogeneity with low-grade fissuring of the medial facet and median ridge.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Mild lateral patellar tilt and translation. Mild patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Top normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 17 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Tricompartmental chondrosis, most significant in the lateral compartment.
2.	Small knee joint effusion.

There is medial meniscal extrusion at the level of the body, deemed secondary to an undisplaced degenerative type tear through the corresponding posterior horn and root.  
Mildly degenerate but otherwise intact lateral meniscus, normal cruciate and collateral ligaments, popliteus, patellar tendon and distal iliotibial band. Chronic, quiescent looking calcific distal insertional quadriceps tendinopathy is present anteriorly. 
 No fracture or marrow infiltration, minimal intra-articular fluid, probably within normal physiological limits.  Mild age-related thinning of tricompartmental articular cartilage, probably most apparent at the medial weightbearing compartment. Tiny focus of high-grade cartilage loss with associated faint focal reactive marrow changes is noted adjacent to the median ridge of the patella.  Small focus of grade 3 cartilage loss noted at the central portion of the lateral tibial plateau. Grossly unremarkable imaged extra-articular soft tissues.

Menisküs hacminde azalma, posterior horn ve gövde kesiminde ise grade III dejenerasyon izlenmiştir.Arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir. Anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyona sekonder sinyal değişikliği izlenmiştir. Gastrocnemius medial krus proksimal insersiyo düzeyinde tendinozis ile uyumlu sinyal değişikliği izlenmiştir. Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur. Patella medial fasette kartilaj bütünlüğü belirgin incelmiştir. Medial retinakulumda da fokal sinyal artışı izlenmiştir. Pes anserin bursasında da sıvı artışı izlenmiştir.Eklemde sıvı artışı saptanmamıştır. Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapıların sinyal intensiteleri doğaldır.Tibia femoral eklem düzeyinde kemik yapı köşelerinde osteofitik sivrileşme izlenmiştir. Tibia femoral eklem medialinde eklem aralığında daralma, ekleme komşu tibia medial platoda subkondral alanda milimetrik kist ve ödem izlenmiştir. Bu seviyede femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda destrüksiyon izlenmiştir. Bulgular dejeneratif artrit lehine yorumlanmıştır. Sonuç: Gonartroz, medial menisküste mediale ekstrüzyon, volüm kaybı ve grade III meniskopati, anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyon, gastrocnemius medial krus tendinozisi, pes anserin bursiti, patella medial fasette grade III kondromalazi.
